response.overview: Chica Light is played by ALECA, a new Wanka actress, who lives the dreams of the Andean Top Model on the mystical natural catwalk of the Andes. An incredible message of tradition, immersed in mysticism, song and charm in a fictional film that was made in the Andes of Peru, a current derived from the fashion and novo-Andean arts. The fantastic golden forest, the sanctuary of Arwaturo, the strange hills of Torre Torre, and many other locations create magic in this Huancayo film of Bollywood-quality cinema, as many have described it. Although the work and evolution of Andean Wanka cinema is still in progress, various formats are being explored.
